content.text:
Fixed. `to_cents` in `ledger/currency.py` used `int(amount * 100)`, which truncates. `19.99 * 100` evaluates to `1998.9999…`, so the result was 1998 instead of 1999. I changed it to `round(amount * 100)`.

The full test suite now passes (5 tests, including the four in `tests/test_totals.py`).
